_comment: Exercises the two documented email-safe degradations: a gradient background (must degrade to its first colour stop — EmailRendererTest::test_a_gradient_background_degrades_to_its_first_stop_colour_in_email) and an align value (must be dropped entirely on the email surface — BlockTreeRenderer::resolveClass()'s docblock, docs/email-system.md §4). Both are supports-level, not attributes.
